datasets.name: annual_revenue_yoy
queryLines:
WITH annual AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(departure_date) AS booking_year,
    SUM(ticket_price * (1 - discount_pct) + tax_pct) AS net_revenue
  FROM
    tpc_a_dev.gold.fact_bookings
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  booking_year,
  net_revenue,
  net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY booking_year) AS yoy_change,
  ROUND(
    (net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY booking_year))
      / LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY booking_year)
      * 100,
    2
  ) AS yoy_pct
FROM
  annual
ORDER BY
  booking_year

datasets.name: top10_routes_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.name AS route_name,
  SUM(fb.ticket_price * (1 - fb.discount_pct) + fb.tax_pct) AS net_revenue
FROM
  tpc_a_dev.gold.fact_bookings fb
    LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_route r
      ON fb.route_id = r.route_id
    LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.silver.booking b
      ON fb.booking_id = b.bk_bookingid
    LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_passenger p
      ON b.bk_passengerid = p.passenger_id
    LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_geography g
      ON p.nation_key = g.nation_id
WHERE
  (
    :booking_date.min IS NULL
    OR fb.departure_date >= :booking_date.min
  )
  AND (
    :booking_date.max IS NULL
    OR fb.departure_date <= :booking_date.max
  )
  AND (
    :passenger_regions IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:passenger_regions, g.region_name)
  )
  AND (
    :travel_purposes IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:travel_purposes, p.travel_purpose)
  )
GROUP BY
  r.name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top10_passengers_share
datasets.displayName: Top 10 Passengers Share of Total Revenue
queryLines:
WITH passenger_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    b.bk_passengerid AS passenger_id,
    SUM(fb.ticket_price * (1 - fb.discount_pct) + fb.tax_pct) AS net_revenue
  FROM

      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.silver.booking b
        ON fb.booking_id = b.bk_bookingid
  GROUP BY
    1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM
    passenger_revenue
)
SELECT
  p.passenger_id,
  p.name AS passenger_name,
  pr.net_revenue,
  ROUND(pr.net_revenue / t.total_revenue * 100, 2) AS pct_of_total_revenue
FROM
  passenger_revenue pr
    CROSS JOIN totals t
    LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_passenger p
      ON pr.passenger_id = p.passenger_id
ORDER BY
  pr.net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: route_rank_by_purpose
datasets.displayName: Route Revenue Ranking by Travel Purpose
queryLines:
WITH route_purpose AS (
  SELECT
    p.travel_purpose,
    r.name AS route_name,
    SUM(fb.ticket_price * (1 - fb.discount_pct) + fb.tax_pct) AS net_revenue
  FROM
    tpc_a_dev.gold.fact_bookings fb
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.silver.booking b
        ON fb.booking_id = b.bk_bookingid
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_passenger p
        ON b.bk_passengerid = p.passenger_id
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_route r
        ON fb.route_id = r.route_id
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)
SELECT
  travel_purpose,
  route_name,
  net_revenue,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY travel_purpose ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM
  route_purpose
ORDER BY
  travel_purpose,
  revenue_rank

datasets.name: passenger_vs_airline_geo
queryLines:
WITH passenger_geo AS (
  SELECT
    g.region_name,
    SUM(fb.ticket_price * (1 - fb.discount_pct) + fb.tax_pct) AS passenger_region_revenue
  FROM
    tpc_a_dev.gold.fact_bookings fb
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.silver.booking b
        ON fb.booking_id = b.bk_bookingid
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_passenger p
        ON b.bk_passengerid = p.passenger_id
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_geography g
        ON p.nation_key = g.nation_id
  GROUP BY
    1
),
airline_geo AS (
  SELECT
    g.region_name,
    SUM(fb.ticket_price * (1 - fb.discount_pct) + fb.tax_pct) AS airline_region_revenue
  FROM
    tpc_a_dev.gold.fact_bookings fb
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_airline a
        ON fb.airline_id = a.airline_id
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_geography g
        ON a.nation_key = g.nation_id
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(pg.region_name, ag.region_name) AS region_name,
  COALESCE(pg.passenger_region_revenue, 0) AS passenger_region_revenue,
  COALESCE(ag.airline_region_revenue, 0) AS airline_region_revenue,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(pg.passenger_region_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(ag.airline_region_revenue, 0),
    2
  ) AS revenue_gap
FROM
  passenger_geo pg
    FULL OUTER JOIN airline_geo ag
      ON pg.region_name = ag.region_name
ORDER BY
  region_name

datasets.name: airline_concentration
queryLines:
WITH airline_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    a.name AS airline_name,
    SUM(fb.ticket_price * (1 - fb.discount_pct) + fb.tax_pct) AS net_revenue
  FROM
    tpc_a_dev.gold.fact_bookings fb
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_airline a
        ON fb.airline_id = a.airline_id
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.silver.booking b
        ON fb.booking_id = b.bk_bookingid
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_passenger p
        ON b.bk_passengerid = p.passenger_id
      LEFT JOIN tpc_a_dev.gold.dim_geography g
        ON p.nation_key = g.nation_id
  WHERE
    (
      :booking_date.min IS NULL
      OR fb.departure_date >= :booking_date.min
    )
    AND (
      :booking_date.max IS NULL
      OR fb.departure_date <= :booking_date.max
    )
    AND (
      :passenger_regions IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:passenger_regions, g.region_name)
    )
    AND (
      :travel_purposes IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:travel_purposes, p.travel_purpose)
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM
    airline_revenue
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ar.airline_name,
    ar.net_revenue,
    t.total_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ar.net_revenue DESC) AS rnk
  FROM
    airline_revenue ar CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN rnk <= 5 THEN airline_name
    ELSE 'All other airlines'
  END AS airline_group,
  SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / MAX(total_revenue) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_total_revenue
FROM
  ranked
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
